question: What evidence do we have that the Dunmoor East cost increase was prudent?
summary: The record shows why the cost rose and that each step was approved: a Level 03 WIN approval with contingency, four change orders each tied to a found condition (concrete, abatement, out-of-level floors, the extension), and the project manager's reports. One gap: no budget revision has been raised for the overrun yet.

blocks.title: Evidence for the Dunmoor East increase
rows: $51.6M approved with $4.15M contingency; above 10% returns to Level 03
CO-001 concrete deterioration, CO-002 abatement: conditions found on opening
CO-003 floors out of level, CO-004 extension
Contingency drawn; Filters 10 and 12 risk named
PM asks to raise the revision now

blocks.markdown: **What a commission would still ask for.** A WIN budget revision that approves the new total before further commitments, and whether Filters 10 and 12 were inspected before the Phase 2 award. Dunmoor is not in a rate case this year, so this is the record that would support a future one.
This answer lists the evidence; it does not decide prudence. That is the commission's call.
